info.name: Get NFT Transfers by wallet address

params.name: chain
params.description: The chain to query

params.name: address
params.description: The wallet address of the sender or recipient of the transfers

params.name: contract_addresses
params.description: List of contract addresses of transfers

params.name: format
params.description: The format of the token ID

params.name: from_block
params.description:
The minimum block number from which to get the transfers
* Provide the param 'from_block' or 'from_date'
* If 'from_date' and 'from_block' are provided, 'from_block' will be used.

params.name: to_block
params.description: To get the reserves at this block number

params.name: from_date
params.description:
The date from where to get the transfers (format in seconds or datestring accepted by momentjs)
* Provide the param 'from_block' or 'from_date'
* If 'from_date' and 'from_block' are provided, 'from_block' will be used.

params.name: to_date
params.description:
Get transfers up until this date (format in seconds or datestring accepted by momentjs)
* Provide the param 'to_block' or 'to_date'
* If 'to_date' and 'to_block' are provided, 'to_block' will be used.

params.name: include_prices
params.description: Should NFT last sale prices be included in the result?

params.name: limit
params.description: The desired page size of the result.

params.name: order
params.description: The order of the result, in ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC)

params.name: cursor
params.description: The cursor returned in the previous response (used for getting the next page).

items.docs: Get NFT transfers for a wallet, with filters like `contract_addresses` and other parameters. Supports ERC-721, ERC-1155 as well as custom contracts such as CryptoPunks and CryptoKitties.
